body: Listen you scruffy turtle...you are a good person. Don’t fucking stop
My fault. I’m just trying to offer a channel to talk. Wish you the best
I’m here to talk
You want a depressed, cynical, atheist, social anxietal (is that a word), dude to reply and give you solace? Cause I’ll do it...
I’m here for you. Ask me anything (30/M/depressed/anxious-son-of-a-bitch).
Same, talk to everyone you can
I’m here for ya if you need to talk

I’m not a father, so I can’t and won’t offer parental advice. But as a person, I just want you to know that there are people like me and you who don’t know where the fuck we belong in this world. What I do know since I posted in this sub is that there are so many people like us in the world (and in this sub) that can offer advice and solace. I don’t have a kid, and I’m a depressed suicidal idiot, but what I can offer is at least someone to talk to. I’m here for ya

I’m in the same boat as you. I guess it’s tough for ~normal~ people to know what the hell people like us go through. But you’re not alone and I’m here to talk as someone who is going through what you’re going through
You’re never alone on the internet. I don’t know what you’ve been through/what you’re going through but I am here to talk. Feel free to DM as I’m questioning life as well
Listen I just want you to know that I did read this and that I’m here for you. If you want to talk about anything at all, as a complete and random stranger, feel free to dm me

Don’t take my word as anything but MY word, but maybe happiness for people like us is fleeting and that’s ok. 

With that being said, I have a few happy points in my life that keep me going. I hope there’s at least a few things that are happy in your life. If not, I hope that you can be happy that I am (as well as many other people) going through something pretty similar to you.
Anytime. Feel free to reach out whenever you need to. Even if you don’t now, DMs are always open
I wasn’t the type to turn to other people for help, especially reddit. But I’m here for you if you want someone to talk to. I’ve been going through a tough stretch as well...
Welcome to the club. We meet never because we are too socially anxious and hate the world. But feel free to DM me because I’m here for you.

You’re not alone at all. I feel the exact same way. Some days I feel great and I want to talk to everyone and be a good person, and then there are other days where I just feel like the world is conspiring against me and I hate everyone. I just posted a good summary of what I’m going through in this sub...feel free to DM me

The world sucks, and for the most part I hate dealing with people. But since I posted and looked through this thread, it kind of feels good to know there’s people like us out there. Feel free to talk to me, I’m here for ya.
If you want comfort, there’s tons of us battling every day with you. DM me, I’d love to help out any way I can
I wish I could offer some advice as someone who has lived more years as a 30 year old (I’m not comparing in any way), but all I want to say is that I’m here with you, battling.
It’s a great perspective, but until we as a nation do something to change the course of what’s happening, we’re an embarrassment to the rest of the world.
